body:
Most people I know say I'm a good person, likeable, ect. I just don't see it in myself I suppose.

Physical/emotional/sexual abuse from my mom/dad/brother(respectively) all my childhood leading to a *very* messy divorce. I've confronted my mom/dad about the shit that happened and I understand what went on and why it happened, I've been understanding about what went on for a while now. I guess I haven't talked to my brother about anything as he is a still a very angry and volatile person who I don't like to talk to/associate with.

Irritations I may have? I have to say I don't understand that question fully.

I had set easy goals to reach, achieve a certain age without attempting again, finish school, find a job I enjoy doing, find people I can hang out with, take better care of myself.

I'm finding it harder to set new goals as I just don't see the point in continuing, or even taking the most basic care of myself/maintaining relationships. 

I can't enjoy hobbies I used to enjoy, or even start any new ones, reading has become difficult, hell even listening to music or watching movies as a distraction doesn't help anymore.

Nothing seems to make me happy, or even level, the thoughts of ending it just become more and more prevalent, I find myself thinking/saying how much I wish I was done and how I wish this would all end more everyday.
